name: Clean Maintenance
description: Overrides the default Drupal maintenance page with a custom, cleaner template driven by the site name and configured maintenance message.
project_description:
What is Clean maintenance? 
 Clean maintenance is a simple module that changes the look and feel of the maintenance page.

 Features 
 
 Replaces Drupal's standard maintenance page with a clean, nice looking, maintenance page 
 Easy setup, as you just install the module 
 Don't have to worry about a custom design, coding, or branding when going into maintenance mode 
 
 Why? 
 With this module there is no need for a custom design or coding.

 What does it do? 
 It changes the look and feel of the maintenance page when the site is in maintenance mode.
